TC-20/S11.productIssue: Gated (U1: TFA-92598 in progress); whose day counts is Q9. A Hospital patient pre-rounded 11 h ago (19:xx UTC, 04:xx Tokyo) and read at 06:xx UTC has gone back to Pending. Pending means 'not yet prepped', yet the pre-round text is still on the chart. The server-day rule resets the badge at the server's UTC midnight, not at the physician's day or the 12 h window. In Tokyo a pre-round done before 09:00 flips at 09:00. In New York every pre-round still showing at 20:00 that evening flips then. Also known: an open task 37 h after the last processing is still counted on the row (no Hospital open-task window on main, TFA-94699).
